purpose: Determine whether preserving raw PnP depth while applying the cross-fitted yaw-harmonic correction only to tracker y/z improves the downstream combined-motion physical fit.
motivation_evidence: Nested outer-session measurement selection chose cross_yz_only in all five folds, tied exactly with full_xyz on current cross-depth error.
The frozen coordinate intervention found truth depth alone had negligible effect on future cross-depth error, while tracker-y restoration dominated.
candidate: crossfit_yaw_harmonic_cross_yz: corrected tracker y/z with raw tracker x depth
reference: crossfit_yaw_harmonic full xyz correction from the parent replay
dataset_and_split: same 144 formal combined sessions and the same held-session correction fold per session
selection: Prefer yz-only only if 55 mm coverage is no worse and P50, P90 and P95 are all no worse than full xyz at every constant-twist horizon; otherwise retain full xyz.
status_boundary: offline oracle-identity downstream diagnostic; not production authorization
